constrained-v1.decoding: pinyin-constrained beam (width 4, fuzzy pairs an/ang en/eng in/ing z/zh c/ch s/sh), invariant seed context '。', no prompt, no chat template

conclusion: Constrained decoding beats the prompt route decisively at the same model size: 89.9% vs 72.6% sentence accuracy. The prompt route is effectively non-functional on 0.5B for this dataset (910/974 empty suggestions; its accuracy equals the dictionary fallback). The constrained decoder's output is legal by construction (pinyin mask + fuzzy gate), so its 11 rejections are the only failure mode short of wrong-but-legal readings. Latency parity: both ~150ms p50 on MPS fp16; the constrained route spends its budget on forward passes instead of prompt prefill, and every output token is legal so no output-cleaning gate ever discards a response.
